chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus, from al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: When the sun passes the zenith, the time of the two prayers has entered.

key_terms.الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the two prayers, meaning zuhr and ʿasr

ai.seo_question: When does the time for zuhr and ʿasr prayers begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the sun declines from its zenith, the time for both zuhr and ʿasr prayers begins. It is a jurisprudential report used in discussions of the beginning of the prayer times.
